subject: Senior stakeholder sync & EB scheduling — proposed MAP and evaluation timeline
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Walters <sam.walters@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Senior stakeholder sync & EB scheduling — proposed MAP and evaluation timeline

Hi Sam,

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. To keep momentum toward the Q4 close, I attached a draft mutual action plan (MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short EB agenda (EB_agenda_draft.pdf). Key asks from our side so we can finalize the timeline:

- Can you confirm the executive sponsor and a technical champion who will attend the executive briefing (EB)?
- Does the week of Dec 14–18 work for a 60-minute EB (goal: align execs on success criteria and close plan)?
- Is Acme able to provide SOC2 artifacts (high-level) and a point-of-contact for procurement?
- Proposed evaluation milestones: 2-week pilot (baseline tests), mid-point review, final acceptance. Any constraints we should include?

Tentative owners are in the MAP draft — I left open the exec rows for your sponsor assignment. If Dec 15 or Dec 16 works we can lock the EB and circulate calendar invites.

Linking the HubSpot deal for context: https://hubspot.redwood/deal/ACME-2026-045

Thanks — I’ll coordinate the internal roster once I have the attendee names.

Best,

Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet), EB_agenda_draft.pdf (1 page)
From: Sam Walters <sam.walters@acmecloud.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: legal.ops@acmecloud.com
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Senior stakeholder sync & EB scheduling — proposed MAP and evaluation timeline

Sean,

Appreciate the clear plan and the docs. High level notes:

- Exec sponsor will be Anika Rao, VP Product (she’s confirmed tentative availability).
- Technical champion: I’ll loop in our Head of Platform but we’ll confirm the name by Friday.
- Procurement/legal are looped (legal.ops@acmecloud.com) — they asked for SOC2 artifacts and a short list of required evidence.
- Evaluation: we want to run a 2-week pilot starting around Dec 12 if possible, with mid-point check on Day 7 and a final review Day 14. Are there any system/infra lead times we should be aware of?

Dec 15 looks promising for an EB on our side; I’ll confirm Anika’s calendar and get back by EOD Friday.

Also copying procurement for any contract/terms heads-up.

Thanks,
Sam Walters
Director, Platform Engineering
Acme Cloud

(Attachment request: SOC2-evidence-request.docx)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Senior stakeholder sync & EB scheduling — proposed MAP and evaluation timeline

Folks,

Thanks Sean — looping in recommended attendee mapping and a proposed EB slot. I built a lightweight roster that maps Redwood owners to Acme roles (see attendee_roster.csv). High-level suggestions:

- Exec Briefing primary slot: Dec 15, 10:00–11:00 PT (60m). Backup slot: Dec 16, 14:00–15:00 PT.
- Redwood attendees proposed: Sean (exec strategic), Marissa (product/EB lead), Priyom (solutions/POC), Olga (security/compliance lead).
- EB goals (one-pager attached): align on acceptance criteria, timeline to pilot, and procurement blockers. Keep the briefing tight (30–45 mins for execs, 15 mins for Q&A).

I also added suggested MAP updates: identify milestone owners (Redwood vs Acme), include acceptance thresholds (latency p95, error rate), and a procurement checklist.

If Sam confirms Anika, I recommend we reserve Dec 15 as primary and start drafting the calendar invite and the MAP with assigned owners.

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: attendee_roster.csv, one-pager-EB-goals.md
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Walters <sam.walters@acmecloud.com>, legal.ops@acmecloud.com
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 5 Dec 2026 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Senior stakeholder sync & EB scheduling — proposed MAP and evaluation timeline

Hi Sam / legal team,

Couple of procurement/terms items to flag early so procurement can evaluate before EB:

- Standard commercial redlines: liability cap tied to contract value, data retention term length, and an explicit SLA for inference availability during pilot.
- We can offer a 30-day acceptance window after pilot completion tied to the MAP acceptance criteria.
- DocuSign link for the SOW + standard T&Cs (pre-populated) here: https://docusign.com/txn/ACME-2026-045

For evaluation metrics, we propose the following minimal set to include in the MAP:
  - Latency: p95 under 350ms for 2k token requests
  - Throughput: sustained 100 reqs/min for baseline workload
  - Availability: 99.5% for pilot window
  - Quality gates: generation BLEU/ROUGE proxies + a short prompt set for acceptance.

If procurement wants different thresholds, we’re happy to align; having these in the MAP helps speed acceptance. I’ll add these to MAP_v1 and circulate V2 along with the updated attendee roster.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
From: Sam Walters <sam.walters@acmecloud.com>

Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 15:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Senior stakeholder sync & EB scheduling — proposed MAP and evaluation timeline

Team,

Confirming Dec 15, 10:00–11:00 PT for the executive briefing — Anika Rao will attend. Our technical champion (Jae Kim, Head of Platform) will join the EB and will be copied on the calendar invite when Marissa sends it.

Legal confirmed they can provide SOC2 artifacts and will review the DocuSign SOW; they requested the MAP with assigned owners and the proposed evaluation thresholds (Priyom’s suggested metrics look reasonable).

Next steps from our side: I’ll ensure procurement has the DocuSign link on Monday and confirm the technical champion contact. From Redwood, please send updated MAP (V2) with owner assignments and the calendar invite.

Looking forward to the EB — thanks for organizing.

Sam
Director, Platform Engineering
Acme Cloud
